title: Éléments de géométrie algébrique (EGA) — Édition française diplomatique cumulative / Cumulative Diplomatic French Edition
description:
Lire d'abord / Read first: open 00_EGA_FR_CUMULATIVE_LINKED_READER.pdf. This exact cumulative release contains EGA I (including Chapter 0), complete EGA II, complete EGA III-1 and complete EGA III-2. The wider French EGA I–IV transcription remains in progress.

The direct-NUMDAM French text is diplomatic. CORR43 catalogues the reversed, ill-typed composition identity in the remark after EGA I 1.2.3; the diplomatic source and reader body remain byte-identical. Editable TeX, exact source identities, decisions, corrections, inverses, build evidence, visual QA and SHA-256 manifests are included in the language release.
